### Why have I reset this blog?

I am resetting this blog to restart with guiding principals.
I started blogging and posting projects early this year, however with the recent explosion of AI use in coding and implemetation in every IDE, I found it impossible to not let it take over half the posts and projects I was doing.

I want to ensure that each line of code, and each word spoken in this blog is my own, to reflect my learning and growth as a developer, and to ensure that I am not just regurgitating AI generated content.

From now on, my posts will be entirely hand written and fall into the following three categories:
- Personal Blog
- Data Science and Machine Learning Projects
- Open Source AI Engineering Projects

I have also temporarily given up on the idea of learning front end development, I was not finding it enjoyable and I want to ensure that I maintain interest and passion for the projects I am working on, so I will be focusing on back end dev / AI engineering and data science for the foreseeable future.

Thanks!
